critical_code_review_comments: In PUT /users/profile, update_fields filters out None values (if v is not None). This means sending iban=null from frontend will NOT clear saved banking data. If user wants to delete their IBAN, they'd need to send empty string '' which the frontend does with 'iban: iban.trim() || null'. Minor limitation - if user clears the IBAN field and saves, the null value is filtered and old IBAN stays in DB. Could be a UX issue but not blocking.
user@winek.app has 'coach' role (was converted at some point). This is fine - banking section appears regardless of role, and all 7 sections tested correctly with coach user.
